name: Improved Hide In Plain Sight
body:
You are able to hide in plain sight even while further away from shadows than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 6 ranks, 1st-level shadowdancer

Benefit: You are able to hide in plain sight as long as you are within 20 feet of an area of dim light, plus 5 feet per 2 levels of shadowdancer you possess beyond the first (25 feet at level 3, 30 feet at level 5, and so on, to a maximum of 40 feet at level 9). For every 5 feet away you are from the shadows beyond the first 10 feat, you suffer a -1 penalty to your Stealth check.
